title: POST /v1/config response
description: Carries one document: the organization's served config. A response the client cannot parse or execute is refused whole, and the cached config keeps collecting.

config.description: The served YAML document, standard base64. The stored bytes are served verbatim. The client caches those exact bytes only after parsing and resolving them successfully; rejection preserves the last working cache.

expires_at.description: When this document goes stale: server clock plus the control-plane config TTL. Expiry does not stop collection: the client keeps running on the cached config and stamps config_expired, because source stores are reaped on their own schedules and a halted client loses data permanently.
